partially_covered.missing: Still only basic organization attributes (name, address, identifier, global location number); lacks contact info (phone, email), legal form, or other organizational metadata.
Still only item name and net price; missing product codes (e.g., GTIN), item descriptions, and units of measure.
No explicit OWL or SHACL modeling of mandatory D96A fields or directory validation; SHACLConstraint class is present but not detailed or connected to shapes/fields.

cq_coverage.details: CQ coverage remains strong for structure, roles, and invoice data. Organization and item detail is still basic. Validation/mandatory field requirements remain implicit and not machine-actionable.

strengths: Rich multi-level hierarchy (Envelope > Message > Section > Line)
Good use of restrictions and property characteristics
weaknesses: No general class axioms (GCAs) for advanced semantic definitions
Limited use of domain-specific disjointness (segments, elements could be more strictly separated)
No modeling of SHACL constraint details or D96A mandatory field requirements

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Minor risk if new properties added without domain/range
P7: Minor risk if data properties lack inverses (not required, but completeness)
P13: Lack of advanced disjointness among technical classes
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet should succeed; no illegal datatypes or syntactic violations
No use of unsupported datatypes (all xsd: types are OWL 2 core-compliant)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand organization and item information: add properties for contact info (email, phone), legal form, product codes (e.g., GTIN), item description, and units of measure.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables richer queries for CQ5 and CQ8, bringing coverage to 100%.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model mandatory field constraints and D96A directory requirements explicitly, as SHACL shapes or detailed OWL restrictions, and link SHACLConstraint to concrete shapes and fields.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation and full answer to CQ13.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add general class axioms (GCAs) to define, for example, 'ValidInvoice' as one fulfilling all mandatory constraints.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Adds semantic depth and supports advanced reasoning and validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Increase disjointness axioms among EDIFACT segment/element classes (e.g., Segment, CompositeDataElement, SimpleDataElement) to prevent unintended inferences.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves logical consistency and error detection.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add individuals for common EDIFACT segment codes and data element codes to support technical completeness and interoperability.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enhances technical completeness and supports downstream mapping and validation.

suggestions_ignored: Expand organization and item information (CQ5, CQ8)
Model mandatory field constraints and D96A directory requirements (CQ13)
Add individuals for EDIFACT segment/data element codes
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes from previous iteration regarding CQ5, CQ8, or CQ13. No new technical or modeling improvements; all prior weaknesses remain. Ontology remains robust and correct, but improvement suggestions were not implemented.

summary: The ontology remains strong in representing EDIFACT invoice structure, roles, and business concepts, with excellent annotation and correct use of OWL 2 constructs. However, none of the previous review's high- or medium-priority improvements were implemented, leaving CQ5, CQ8, and CQ13 only partially covered. Overall quality and CQ coverage scores are unchanged, and the ontology remains robust but incomplete for advanced validation and semantic queries.
